#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Static/mocked tests only: never call execute_case, vm, runecpp, or checkcertif."""
import importlib.util
import json
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
def module(name, file):
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, HERE / file); m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(m); return m
runner = module("cohort_runner", "cohort_runner.py")
checker = module("cohort_checker", "cohort_checker.py")

class RunnerStaticTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_frozen_bindings_and_complete_mapping(self):
        self.assertEqual(len(runner.verify_frozen()), 18)
        rows, _ = runner.rows_and_bindings()
        mapping = runner.complete_prior_mapping(rows)
        self.assertEqual(set(mapping), {x["curve_uid"] for x in rows})
        self.assertEqual(len(mapping), 21)

    def test_trace_is_printed_only_and_recomputed(self):
        catalog = {"a": "aa", "b": "bb"}
        serial = b"% N_1=101\n% next D is -3\n% route: elliptic\n% retry: 2\n"
        trace = runner.extract_trace(serial, catalog)
        self.assertEqual(trace["unprinted_state"], "UNOBSERVED")
        self.assertEqual([e["kind"] for e in trace["events"]], ["recursive_N", "D", "route", "retry"])
        with self.assertRaises(checker.CheckFailure):
            checker.check_trace({**trace, "unprinted_state": "EXECUTED"}, serial, catalog)

    def test_manifest_refuses_tampering_and_duplicate_output(self):
        frozen = runner.verify_frozen()
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
            d = Path(d); out = d / "out"; out.mkdir()
            p = d / "binding.json"
            p.write_text(json.dumps({"schema": "crypto.autoresearch.nistseed_ecpp_trial_binding.v1", "cohort_index": 0, "output_directory": str(out), "frozen_input_sha256": frozen, "limits": runner.LIMITS, "primary_configuration": {"serial": True, "full_original_data": True, "proving": True, "n_minus_1": True, "n_plus_1": True, "distributed": False, "debug": False, "fresh_vm": True, "fresh_process_rng": "original ModInitialize: srandom(1)"}}))
            self.assertIsInstance(runner.verify_supervisor_manifest(p, 0, out, frozen), dict)
            bad = json.loads(p.read_text()); bad["cohort_index"] = 1; p.write_text(json.dumps(bad))
            with self.assertRaises(runner.Refusal): runner.verify_supervisor_manifest(p, 0, out, frozen)
            with self.assertRaises(runner.Refusal): runner.run(21, out, p)

    def test_aa_comparator_is_semantic(self):
        x = {"curve": {"curve_uid": "fixture"}, "classification": "INDETERMINATE", "legacy_labels_observation_only": [], "limits": {}, "runtime_payloads": [], "kernel": {}, "original_data": {}}
        self.assertTrue(checker.aa_compare(x, dict(x))["equal"])
        y = dict(x); y["classification"] = "different"
        with self.assertRaises(checker.CheckFailure): checker.aa_compare(x, y)

if __name__ == "__main__": unittest.main()
